initial_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: high-resolution transparent game sprite source for Project RL, candidate 108 / D56-BODY01, the existing Eclaireur reconnaissance companion drone.
Input image 1 is an old two-object pixel-art reference sheet: ONLY the intact LIVING scout at the LEFT is the edit target and identity authority. Ignore and do not reproduce the broken object at right. Input image 2 is STYLE ONLY, the already approved Guardian robot: match its crisp dark ink outline, restrained hard-edged cel shading, clearly separated industrial materials and serious graphic-novel finish. Do not borrow its orange palette, humanoid shape or massive proportions.
Redraw the intact living scout from scratch as ONE compact floating mechanical reconnaissance drone in the same almost FRONTAL view and balanced silhouette. Preserve the recognisable rounded ivory / warm bone-white central sensor shell, broad dark horizontal face recess with ONE small electric blue/cyan optical sensor at its center, dark graphite underbody, two short side connectors, and TWO upright compact ivory side thruster pods with dark graphite lower sections and restrained blue luminous accents. The side pods are simple coherent hover engines, not hands, guns, legs, wings or loudspeakers. Keep the same ivory, graphite and blue accents, with the blue limited to purposeful optics and thrusters. The central body should feel functional and slightly worn, not cute, a toy, cartoon mascot or glossy sphere. Keep a few broad beveled armor surfaces and only a few useful panel separations. No heavy microtexture, rivets, dangling cables, smoke or exaggerated glow. The recognition should come from the central visor and two separate side pods, readable negative space between them.
Composition: one complete unarmed hovering drone, broad and LOW, about 1.8 to 1.9 times as wide as high, centered and uncropped; entirely visible connectors and both side pods. Its intended body is approximately 56 pixels wide and 30-32 pixels high when directly reduced for a logical64px tile. A small flying scout stays small relative to the Guardian; do not inflate it to a full tile high. Upper-left lighting, strong clean silhouette, two or three large shades per material. Smooth deliberate illustrated forms, NOT pixel art, NOT nearest-neighbor blocks, NOT a filtered version of the old pixels.
Genuine transparent RGBA background. No floor, ground shadow, halo, flame plume, environmental effect, corpse, alternate pose, extra drone, frame, writing, label or watermark. No weapons, legs, wheels, tracks, orange armor, purple armor or new decorations. Preserve the current content identity and compact noncombat reconnaissance role; only improve drawing quality.
proportion_revision_prompt: Edit the single scout drone in the reference image. Keep its ivory / bone-white armor, graphite frame, blue visor, two side hover pods, serious crisp ink and hard-edged cel-shaded illustration style, exact front view and level symmetrical pose. Change ONLY the proportions to make the full drone more COMPACT horizontally, matching an overall occupied width-to-height ratio of approximately 1.85:1 instead of the current very wide approximately2.5:1. The rounded central sensor shell must stay prominent and should be taller, nearly round. Bring the two side pods MUCH CLOSER to the main body using short dark connectors, slim the pods horizontally and make them a little taller; their tops near the main body mid-height and their bottoms near the main body's bottom. Two clear gaps, two complete pods. Preserve the functional central recessed blue optic, ivory housing and simple graphite underbody. No extra appendages or decoration. Make it legible when the entire body is reduced directly to about56pixels wide by30pixels high. One complete drone only, with generous transparent margins, no crop, no shadow, ground, halo, flame, writing, additional objects or other changes. Genuinely transparent RGBA background.
